params.name: page_size
params.description:
Default page size is 100 which is also the maximum page size.  Query param is "page_size".  If page size is default than this param can be omitted otherwise it must be specified on every page request.
see https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/design_patterns#list_pagination.

params.name: page_token
params.description:
If there are multiple pages, pages 2-N must specify this parameter using the value of next_page_token provided in the previous page's response. The REST query parameter is "page_token".
see https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/design_patterns#list_pagination.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
If there are multiple pages, a sort-order can be used and is applicable to the pages but not to the items in a page. If this parameter is provided on a multi-page request, it must be provided on all subsequent page requests. Supported options are: "display_name asc" (default).
see https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/design_patterns#sorting_order.

params.name: source
params.description:
To filter on a specific source then specify a value here.

 - UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified - an important option for filtering use cases when no preference is desired.  This is not a valid option when creating a subject category
 - SYSTEM_DEFINED: Category is defined by Pryon Cloud Services system
 - USER_DEFINED: Category is defined by users of the system and created via user input
 - QUERY_ATTRIBUTE: A category associated to a content which can be used to improve Exchange response ranking quality based on the context specified in ExchangeInputOption
See "documentation about improving ranking quality" link for more details.

params.name: subject_category_id
params.description: Required.

params.name: direction
params.description:
Filter by relationships having a specific direction.

 - UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified - an important option for filtering use cases when no preference is desired.
This is not a valid option when creating a subject relationship type.
 - UNIDIRECTIONAL: Indicates a one-way relationship from the subject specified by the from_subject_id,
to the subject specified by the to_subject_id.
 - BIDIRECTIONAL: Indicates a two-way relationship between the subject specified by the from_subject_id,
and the subject specified by the to_subject_id.

params.name: term
params.description: If specified then the list will be filtered to the subject term with regard to term_is_prefix and term_is_case_sensitive.

params.name: term_is_prefix
params.description: If specified alongside term then list subjects whose term starts with the string provided.

params.name: term_is_case_insensitive
params.description: If specified alongside term then filter to those that match regardless of lowercase or uppercase.
